claim: The PR adds nothing the library lacks. `my_add_comm (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a` restates core `Nat.add_comm` and its proof is literally `Nat.add_comm a b`. The general `add_comm` is already in Mathlib for every additive commutative magma, ℕ included. So the new theorem is a duplicate alias with a placeholder name, and it looks like a test PR sent upstream from a personal workflow.
requested_change: Close the PR. Users should call `Nat.add_comm` or `add_comm` directly. If the author wants to contribute, point them to the contributing guide and Zulip to find a real target.
evidence: Generic `add_comm` comes from `@[to_additive] theorem mul_comm` at Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Defs.lean:224-225. ℕ's instance uses core `Nat.add_comm` directly (`add_comm := Nat.add_comm`, Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean:36). mlgrep for `MyNewProofs|my_add_comm` finds no use anywhere in Mathlib.

claim: `push_proofs.sh` is the contributor's personal automation, and it has no place in the library. It rewrites the Lean file with a heredoc, runs `git checkout -b feature/your-proofs`, `git add .`, commit and push, then `gh pr create --head batmeezy918:feature/your-proofs`. It is unrelated to any mathematical content, and it would land a script at the repository root that runs `git add .` and pushes to a named personal fork. Mathlib's repo-level shell scripts all live under `scripts/`, and this one does not belong even there.
requested_change: Remove `push_proofs.sh` from the PR entirely. Do not move it into `scripts/`.
evidence: diff.patch adds push_proofs.sh at the repo root (24 lines: git checkout/add/commit/push plus gh pr create). mlgrep for shebang lines in *.sh finds only scripts/auto_commit.sh, scripts/lake-build-with-retry.sh, scripts/lint-bib.sh and scripts/print-style-errors.sh, all under scripts/.

claim: The description does not do its job. 'Automated PR from Termux using EOF-generated file' says how the PR was produced, not what it adds or why. It gives no motivation, no design choice, and no link to a discussion or downstream use. It also says the content was generated by a script without saying where the Lean content came from, so a maintainer cannot tell whether AI assistance was used, as the contribution policy requires them to be told. The title 'Add MyNewProofs' does not follow Mathlib's `feat(Area): ...` convention and names no mathematical content. Since the title becomes the squash-commit message (.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md:3), it would go into history as-is.
requested_change: If the PR is not simply closed: retitle it in `feat(Algebra/...): ...` form describing the content, state the motivation and any Zulip discussion or downstream use, and say whether and how AI or automated generation produced the Lean code.
evidence: pr.md: title 'Add MyNewProofs', body 'Automated PR from Termux using EOF-generated file'. The same body string is hard-coded in push_proofs.sh (`--body "Automated PR from Termux using EOF-generated file"`).

claim: The new file skips the integration every Mathlib file needs, so CI fails before review can even start. (1) The PR does not touch Mathlib.lean, so the new module is missing from the import-all file and the `lake exe mk_all --check` CI step fails. (2) At this base Mathlib uses the module system (`module` plus `public import` in every file and in Mathlib.lean), but the file has neither. (3) It has no copyright/authors header and no module docstring, both of which the header linter requires.
requested_change: Moot if the PR is closed, as requested above. Any future file must be registered with `lake exe mk_all`, start with a copyright header and `module`, use `public import`, and carry a `/-! ... -/` module docstring.
evidence: CI runs `lake exe mk_all --check` (.github/workflows/build_template.yml:410-416, failure message at :543). Mathlib.lean has 7796 `public import Mathlib.` lines, e.g. Mathlib.lean:364 `public import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Basic`. Module header convention: Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Basic.lean:1-15 and Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean:1-10. Header linter rules: Mathlib/Tactic/Linter/Header.lean:29-33.

claim: The file is in the wrong place under a non-descriptive name. A lemma about ℕ addition belongs with the ℕ algebra files (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/), which is exactly where `Nat.add_comm` is already used. A top-level `Mathlib/Algebra/MyNewProofs.lean` says nothing about its content. The file also imports `Mathlib.Algebra.Ring.Basic` and `Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Basic` for a statement that needs only core Lean.
requested_change: Moot if the PR is closed. Otherwise, content should go into the existing file for its subject (e.g. Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean) with only the imports it needs, not into a new catch-all file.
evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Nat/Defs.lean:30-36 defines ℕ's additive instance, using `Nat.add_comm`. The new file's proof `Nat.add_comm a b` uses no declaration from either import.
